requirements.text: The existing program's own steps are kept, in order: launch Chromium, open books.toscrape.com, click Travel, then click the first book, print its title and close its own browser (in Rust: attach to the launched browser only once its debugging port answers).
The added step runs right after the Travel click, on the page the program already drives (borrowed or attached), not on a new page or browser.
It extracts, with a language model that is actually named or configured, the title and price of every listed book (a list schema) and outputs the result.
The step never closes, navigates or takes over the program's browser or page: ending or closing its own objects only releases the borrow or drops its connection.
A failure of the step (model, attach, extraction) is caught, and the program continues with its page and closes its browser.
The step is awaited to completion and releases its own resources (connection, Run, Stagehand instance) before the program's driver acts again.

Retries the CdpUrl Session until the port answers, extracts with a named model and a typed schema, reports an Err and carries on, and kills its own browser after closing the Run and connection; the Run is closed unfinished (stopped, not finished), which the task does not require.

Matches the leader reference: opens a debugging port, attaches Stagehand 3 by the webSocketDebuggerUrl, extracts on the program's page with a named model, catches failures and closes Stagehand in finally, which only drops its socket.

programs.notes: The added step is right (named model, typed schema, Err reported and the program carries on, wait for load only), but the program opens the CdpUrl Session right after spawning Chromium with no wait for the debugging port, so the attach can fail before any page step runs.

Same structure as the leader reference: debugging port, attach by webSocketDebuggerUrl, extract with `{ page }` and a named model, failure caught, Stagehand closed (socket only) before the program carries on; it uses an OpenAI model, so it needs OPENAI_API_KEY rather than the Anthropic key.
